idea-plugin.name: Retro 82 Theme
idea-plugin.description:
Retro 82 for JetBrains

A warm retro dark theme (navy, teal, cream, orange) matching the omarchy retro-82 system theme. Ships two variants: a classic UI theme and an Islands variant (parentTheme "Islands Dark") for the new UI. Editor colors via the bundled Retro 82 scheme.
